Public Transport Timisoara is a dedicated transportation app, which helps you get real-time vehicle arrival times from Timișoara's local public transport system (STPT) directly to your iPhone or iPad.

Use your device to see the arrival times obtained from the real-time GPS tracking units installed on all public transport vehicles (trams, buses, and trolleybuses). The app connects directly to Timisoara's Local Transport Authority's (STPT) servers and presents the arrival information in a format optimized for mobile devices. The estimated times are from the real-time GPS tracking units installed on the public transport vehicles and represent the real-time traffic situation in the city.

It features a simple and intuitive interface designed for quick browsing and information access. Arrival times are displayed in two formats:

- N min the live time, obtained via GPS until the vehicle arrives in the station

- HH: MM the scheduled vehicle arrival time. The scheduled time will most commonly be displayed when the vehicle has not yet left the end-station (i.e. no vehicle heading your way)

Features:

- Does not require GPS activated on your device (saves battery)
- Easy to understand and to use
- Always up to date
- It contains all the stations from Timișoara and the ones from the metropolitan area (Dumbrăvița, Moșnița, Ghiroda, etc.)
- Add to Favorites any routes for quick access
